description: Returns the rank of a number in a list of numbers: its size relative to other values in the list.

params.description: The number for which the rank will be returned.
params.name: arg1

params.description: An array or range of numbers. Nonnumeric values are ignored.
params.name: arg2

params.description: The numeric value that specifyes how to order the numbers. If it is 0 or omitted, the rank in the list will be sorted in descending order.Any other numeric value means that the rank in the list will be sorted in ascending order.
params.name: arg3

signature: RANK(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number[], arg3?: ApiRange | ApiName | boolean): number
